messages:
alex: Heads up — spotted 3 more cards flapping in us-west-2-gpu-pool. Two nodes drained for persistent Xid 31/79 errors. Opening RMA but need logistics plan — vendor flagged depot swap hold because serials don't match manifest. Anyone on call for serial reconciliation? cc @logistics-bot :eyes:
ops-bot: Detected GPU ECC soft error spike on node gpu-uw2-14; Xid=79, rebooted once, then drain started. Auto-ticket VND-4821 created.
maya: On it. Can you paste the node serials? I ran `redwood-inv list --node gpu-uw2-14 --format=csv` and got S/N: RWD-91FF-33, RWD-91FF-34 (two cards). Vendor RMA says depot manifest expected RWD-91FF-35 for that chassis. :thinking_face:
sandeep: Weird — last firmware rollout bumped card re-ID? There's an edge case in the kconfig that overwrote metadata during flash. I'm checking git history. If serials are incorrect we can't depot-swap; vendor will quarantine.
devon: Short-term: can we swap from the spare pool? spare-uw2 has 2 compatible A100:80GB. If we reassign one, we keep capacity. I can coordinate swap but need manual manifest entry for RMA.
logistics-bot: RMA plan: VND-4821 assigned. Depot swap window 2026-03-20 09:00–17:00 PT. Courier pickup needs manifest to match vendor S/N list or they will reject. Link: https://vendor.example/rma/4821
alex: Procedure I propose: (1) mark current S/N as 'pending-escrow' in inventory, (2) create temporary manifest mapping physical slot -> actual S/N, (3) dispatch spare from spare-uw2, (4) update RMA ticket with manifest and photos. Who can do photos?
elaine: I can do photos and upload to ticket. Also will note BIOS/FW versions. FYI logs show `nvml: Xid 79 GPU 2` repeated. I'll siphon logs to /tmp/rma/gpu-uw2-14.tar.gz.
maya: Command snippet for draining: ```kubectl drain gpu-uw2-14 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force``` After drain, set node annotation `gpu.redwood/rma=VND-4821` and add label `rma-pending=true`.
sandeep: I've pushed a quick fix to the inventory service to prevent metadata overwrite. PR: https://git.internal/r/inv/merge/210. But until it's deployed, don't trust automated S/N overwrites.
devon: I'll reseal capacity: moving one pod to spot-uw2 and scaling down on-demand; ETA 15m. Also create temp route so jobs don't land on nodes with `rma-pending` label.
alex: Cost note: moving to spot for 4 pods increases latency 2-3ms but saves $0.12/token estimate. Triage approval from finance?
elaine: Finance ok for short-term, confirmed via DM. :thumbsup: / :moneybag:
logistics-bot: Vendor requires S/N in CSV: `slot,serial,model,notes` and a photo per GPU. Please attach by 2026-03-19 20:00 PT.
maya: Upload done: ticket VND-4821 updated. But vendor replied: 'manifest mismatch unresolved; we need chassis-level checksum.' Escalating to account manager.
alex: Action items summarized: alex mark inventory pending-escrow; elaine take photos + logs; devon move workload + assign spare; sandeep follow up on PR and confirm if firmware re-ID issue; maya keep vendor updated. Tagging @ops-bot for next-step reminder tomorrow 09:00 PT. :calendar: 
ops-bot: Reminder set: `RMA followup VND-4821` at 2026-03-20T09:00:00-07:00.
